verdict.rationale: Swell's evidence is entirely about developer-side tooling (REST API, custom models, CLI, functions, AI coding-agent skills for building storefronts) — there is no documented agent-commerce endpoint (MCP/UCP or similar) for a shopping agent to discover products and build carts on the storefront. Probes explicitly show no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec discoverable, and no MCP/UCP server is mentioned anywhere.
